name: Mastery
author: OpenFF
description: FF3 as it is, but the four heroes grow FF5's way: every job climbs a ladder of abilities on ABP won in battle, anything learned goes into a free command slot of whatever job is held, and FF5's own jobs stand on FF3's. An Abilities screen in the game's own menu, made of a layout and two MenuBehaviours - the shape of a menu of your own.
